landing.metaTitle: BIST market tracking and paper portfolio
landing.metaDescription: Follow BIST stocks, currencies and precious metals live; build a commission-aware paper portfolio and generate AI reports and Monte-Carlo simulations.
landing.heroTitle: Follow BIST live, build your portfolio risk-free.
landing.heroDescription: Florence brings Borsa İstanbul stocks, currencies and precious metals into one screen. Manage your paper portfolio with realistic, commission-inclusive prices and test decisions with AI reports and Monte-Carlo simulations.
landing.featuresDescription: Everything from market tracking to portfolio analysis in one place.

market.title: Live market data
market.description: BIST stocks, currencies and precious metals, with session hours and price history.

portfolio.title: Paper portfolio with commission
portfolio.description: Simulate trades with the commission rate and inspect cost, return and risk metrics.

reports.title: AI-assisted reports
reports.description: Spend credits on a ticker to generate an analysis report grounded in current data.

simulation.title: Monte-Carlo simulation
simulation.description: Set a target price and horizon; explore the distribution of possible outcomes.

register.title: Sign up
register.description: Open your account in seconds and verify your email.

explore.title: Explore the market
explore.description: Follow stocks, currencies and metals; add favorites to your watchlist.

build.title: Build your portfolio
build.description: Create a portfolio with simulated trades and test it with reports and simulations.

landing.ctaDescription: Create a free account. No credit card, no real money involved.

footer.tagline: BIST market tracking and paper portfolio platform.
